description_en: Modifies the basic information about a control policy
description_zh: 修改控制策略基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-policy --instance-id bastionhost-cn-09k1u8mv501 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 7 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host to which the control policy to modify belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的控制策略所在堡垒机的实例id。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the control policy to modify belongs.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的控制策略所在堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the control policy that you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 指定要修改的控制策略的ID
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the control policy
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的控制策略名称
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en: The new remarks of the control policy
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的控制策略备注
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The priority of the modified control policy. Valid values: 1 to 100. The smaller the value, the higher the priority. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的控制策略的优先级，1~100，数字越小优先级越高。默认 1
parameters.name: priority

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
